title: Tetha Grig
description: Tetha Grig dealt spices on the streets of Daiyu. Obi-Wan Kenobi tried to speak to her for information on Princess Leia Organa's whereabouts, but Grig was pessimistic that any missing person would ever be found on the planet. Failing to sell Kenobi spice, she gave him some for free, telling him it would help him forget the missing girl.
